_notes: Edit this file on GitHub (pencil icon) to change which jobs are collected. Keep the quotes and commas.
search_terms: words Adzuna looks for in job titles. Each term is one search per update.
title_must_include_any: a job title must contain one of these to go on the board.
drop_title_words: jobs with any of these in the title are left off the board.
senior_title_words: jobs with these in the title are marked Senior/lead (the site can hide them).
max_required_years: the site's 'Hide jobs asking N+ years' switch hides jobs asking for more than this.
cities: the city buttons on the site, each with its other spellings. Jobs elsewhere go under 'Other cities'.
keep_days: jobs older than this many days drop off the board.
